item_short_desc: Rothco’s Full Access Gear Bag is your ultimate storage solution for carrying and organizing large tactical, outdoor, or duty gear. Designed with a durable U-shaped zipper, this gear bag provides fast and easy access to the spacious main compartment, so you can quickly grab your essentials when needed. The adjustable padded shoulder straps ensure comfortable transport, whether you're carrying light or heavy loads. For added convenience, the wrap-around carry handles provide a sturdy alternative for lifting and moving your bag with ease.
description: Rothco’s Full Access Gear Bag is your ultimate storage solution for carrying and organizing large tactical, outdoor, or duty gear. Designed with a durable U-shaped zipper, this gear bag provides fast and easy access to the spacious main compartment, so you can quickly grab your essentials when needed. The adjustable padded shoulder straps ensure comfortable transport, whether you're carrying light or heavy loads. For added convenience, the wrap-around carry handles provide a sturdy alternative for lifting and moving your bag with ease. Made from rugged denier polyester, this gear bag is built to withstand the toughest conditions, while the polyurethane-coated interior offers extra protection against the elements. With its generous dimensions of 33 inch x 16 inch x 15 inch, Rothco's Full Access Gear Bag has ample space for all your essential gear, making it ideal for travel, work, and outdoor adventures.
